title: Ticket processing delayed while API remains healthy
customer_impact: New tickets are accepted but background processing is delayed for multiple customers.
scope: API create/read remains available; async processing queue is growing and one worker consumer is absent.

timeline.event: Synthetic journey reported ticket processing timeout.
L2 acknowledged incident and confirmed API readiness remained healthy.
RabbitMQ queue depth increased while consumer count dropped to zero.
Worker logs showed the consumer process had exited after a broker connection interruption.
L2 restarted only the worker service under the approved runbook.
Consumer count recovered, queue drained, and synthetic processing returned to success.

evidence: worker log showed broker connection interruption
synthetic journey recovered after worker-only restart
resolution: Restarted the failed worker consumer using the approved worker-recovery runbook; no code change was required.
